entry.speaker: Varn
entry.text: I remember dying. That is the part that unsettles me — not the death itself, but that I remember it. The chains do not usually allow that kind of continuity.

responses.text: You seem... more yourself than I expected.

more_yourself.speaker: Varn
more_yourself.text: Is that what you see. I am not sure I agree. But I trust you more than I trust my own reflection, so I will take it as meant. Something held when I fell — not the chains. Something else. I think it may be what we built between us.

responses.text: I need to ask you something.

brought_back.speaker: Varn
brought_back.text: Yes. With less of itself intact than before. I feel the gaps — places the chains used to run through that are now silence. I do not know if that silence is loss or something waiting to be named.

responses.text: Is there something I can do?
I need to ask you something.

what_remember.speaker: Varn
what_remember.text: You. The fight. The exact moment I understood that you were not going to stop. It was not rage — just clarity. I remember thinking: this is the correct outcome. Then nothing, until now. That clarity disturbs me more than the death does.

responses.text: Is there something I can do?

something_do.speaker: Varn
something_do.text: Perhaps. There is something I left behind — deliberately, I think, though I cannot be certain. A Warden's Seal. A remnant of the authority I held before the chains changed what I was. I believe I hid it somewhere in the dungeon's deeper rooms. I need to understand what it still means.

responses.text: What would you learn from it?
What do you need from me?
I've been looking for something of yours.

what_learn.speaker: Varn
what_learn.text: Whether the chains were protecting something — or protecting the dungeon from something. I have carried the obligation without ever being certain which direction it pointed. The Seal was made before the chains bound me. It might remember a version of the truth I have since been denied.

will_find.speaker: Varn
will_find.text: I know you will. That is the only certainty I have been able to hold onto since I woke. Go carefully — the dungeon is less structured than it was when I held it together.

seal_returned.speaker: Varn
seal_returned.text: You brought it back. Let me... yes. I remember making this. I remember what I was protecting. The chains were not walls keeping chaos out. They were a promise I made to something I no longer understand. That distinction matters. I am not certain why yet.
